purpose: Reality-first external demand radar for ContextMesh. Prioritize places where a reproducible benchmark, verifier contract, or focused patch can add value without duplicating an active contributor.

targets.title: Ingestion-Time Extension Hook for Knowledge Graph Hygiene
targets.why: The issue explicitly asks for a pre-persistence verification hook over raw source text and resolved graph facts. This is a natural integration boundary for a coverage/provenance-aware verification receipt rather than another memory store.
targets.next_artifact: propose a minimal hook contract: input source span + resolved fact + conflicts + provenance; output accept/refuse/contested + reason + evidence ids + verifier metadata

targets.title: Go max_tokens context-window semantics diverge across paths
targets.why: Silent context-window mis-resolution changes what evidence reaches the model. It matches ContextMesh route-budget correctness work and is currently unclaimed.
targets.next_artifact: reproduce on current main, add parity test for model@provider and unify context-window semantics before proposing a focused Go PR

targets.title: Go/Python media-context truncation parity
targets.why: The same source produces different stored chunk bodies and IDs depending on backend. This is directly about source fidelity and context-window boundaries.
targets.next_artifact: pin a shared fixture and make Go sentence-boundary truncation match Python; keep markdown/HTML and legacy parser_config follow-ups separate if needed

targets.title: Retrieval test should explain why chunks were dropped
targets.why: Their requested retrieval funnel is the same missing diagnostic that our rank-17 reality run exposed. We can contribute measured evidence for why rank/cutoff/drop reasons matter without competing with the existing PR.
targets.next_artifact: share the Cognee rank-17 controlled result and suggest a per-candidate eligibility trace: rank, threshold/cutoff, reason, selected, source id

targets.title: Time-blindness, semantic conflicts, and memory hygiene
targets.why: The thread has real production users and an explicit unresolved question: recency is not truth. ContextMesh can add a verifier-style replay corpus measuring whether contradiction/invalidation policies preserve load-bearing facts.
targets.next_artifact: build a temporal-conflict replay probe before commenting; do not advertise ContextMesh until there is a measured result

avoid_for_now.reason: another contributor has reproduced and prepared a fix

avoid_when: issue already crowded with competing PRs
